vision.heading: Professional solutions for cleaner and healthier indoor air
paragraphs: BasicAir offers air filtration, purification and indoor air quality control solutions for homes, offices, educational and healthcare facilities, hotels, restaurants, retail locations, warehouses and production facilities.

Our team has been working in air quality solutions since 2009. By assessing how spaces are used, pollution sources and ventilation system performance, we select the most suitable technical solution for each site — from air filters and air quality measurement to professional and industrial air purification equipment.
Quality air filtration helps reduce dust, allergens, aerosols and other airborne particles, improving the indoor environment for employees, clients and visitors.

For professional filtration solutions, we partner with Swedish air filtration company Camfil, which has been active in the industry for more than 50 years. Using proven technologies, airflow simulations and site-specific calculations, we help select an effective and economically sound air quality solution.
Contact BasicAir for a consultation and a solution tailored to your premises.
